brief: A white EKG waveform traces across a colored background that shifts to match the pulse color of the line itself. The background and trace colors synchronize as the wave beats, while the viewer observes this rhythmic synchronization without needing to provide any input. The canvas remains static until interaction occurs, defining the piece as a responsive display rather than an autonomous animation or still image.
